'''Veladine''' was the sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Velm]]. It was the outermost planet in the [[Velm system]],<ref name="Velmor Part 1" /> which was located in the [[Halori sector/Legends|Halori sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Veladine's surface consisted of [[Water/Legends|ice]], and it was orbited by three [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Moon/Legends|moonlets]].<ref name="Velmor Part 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veladine was mentioned in the source article ''[[Velmor: Royalty and Rebellion]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplement written by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 6]], [[2003]] for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Velmor Part 1" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Velm [[Star system/Legends|system]], and by extension Veladine, in grid square P-7.<ref name="TEA" />
